title: Rupee slips below 96 per dollar level in early trade - The Economic Times
text:
In a significant market shift, the rupee has dipped to 96 against the US dollar, marking a low not seen in over two months. This decline is attributed to a combination of weak investor confidence and ongoing global economic uncertainties. Challenges from elevated crude oil prices and a strengthening dollar were intensified by the Federal Reserve's latest interest rate increase.
